acceptance.criterion: Durable stages and lost replies resume the same operation after an independent OS process termination.
Task generation/epoch and checkout exclusion fence stale effects; target remains reserved through atomic Main publication.
Receiver reads task revision/digest, original checkpoint artifacts and settled resource receipts before confirmation.
Same logical session/task survives window restart and continues actual tool writes in target; four locale selection and resume are verified.

verificationModel.interaction: agent-driven Electron against local scripted provider with real Gateway, Git worktree and owner stores
verificationModel.process: parent kills isolated Node worker at durable signal; fresh process resumes original operation using real task/session/journal/checkout stores; Workspace persistence and RPC transport are fixture adapters

inheritance: Each command records source hashes and candidate delta. Runtime owner regressions retain identical runtime bytes after UI/test/doc-only changes; final UI journeys bind their built candidate. Failed runs remain separately addressable.
